title: Add thrust
description: Write the rule that accelerates your ship while Up is held. Steering and firing are supplied.
hint: Check keyboard.thrust before calling ship.thrust(). Release Up to test drifting.
starter: # Turn, thrust, and clear the rocks. Momentum carries you forward.

guide.instruction: Check keyboard.thrust before calling ship.thrust(). Release Up to test drifting.
guide.review: Run your rule, then use Check my step.
